summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, here a London Stock Exchange admission-to-trading notice under PRM 1.6.4R) disclosing that 19,352 ordinary shares of 31 pence each, ISIN GB00BN7SWP63, were admitted to trading on the LSE Main Market under existing block-listing admissions tied to the GlaxoSmithKline plc Share Save Plan 2022. Total shares admitted following admission: 4,316,311,662, fully fungible with existing ordinary shares, covering 7 August 2026 to 2 October 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics; routine employee share-plan issuance, no risk-arb angle.
